The inputs by SHA-256 (plan_tool.similarity_entry, at init-block and again at release; the job's similarity entry): B14's script f8305c71... and settings 27db4c3f... (added to stage1_rules.S1_CODE, so the X pack carries them), the prepared manifest 9ed61826... (PREPARED_MANIFESTS) and its dev bank 1438ff51... (SIM_DEV_BANK, the manifest's own entry), the add sets S1 904a0cf1..., S3 a2f18a3d..., S4 24aed3fb... (SIM_ADD_SETS; each the file its add-edit record names). Each add set is bound like an arm's edit (one file for its arm in the edit sources, on disk at the pin) and must be the file the S1, S3 and S4 arm runs of plan.json trained on (every run that names an edit names it; at least one complete).

The runner (job_runner_stage1.py): one step job-I-similarity, venv/bin/python scripts/stage1_s1/overlap_similarity.py --prepared data/kt-prepared/prepared-kt-dolly-olmo2 --recipe REC --add-set S1|S3|S4 edits/<SHA-256>.edit.json <SHA-256> --out job-I/similarity; before it, the plan's entry must carry every pin and every file it names must be packed at that pin (similarity_args), and the sealed-file check covers the script, settings, the W1 modules and labels.json they load, the manifest, the dev bank and the three edit files. After it, job-I/similarity-record.json (exclusive create, canonical JSON; stage1_rules.similarity_record_doc): the output's path and SHA-256, the SHA-256 the script printed, the provenance's hashes, the counts and problems; an output off stage1_rules' pins or a missing printed SHA-256 is a crash that the record explains. Ledger stage: scoring.

On the Mac: the finisher's light check checks every complete similarity job as record-done does (stage1_rules.similarity_record_problem: both files in the pulled tree at JOB-DONE.json's SHA-256, the record rebuilt from the pulled output and equal, no problem); record-done refuses such a job and otherwise prints similarity: [{job, path, sha256, record_sha256}], the strata step's input.
